name: Bed-A-Thon
tagline: Matches student roommates, recommends apartments for the group and has an agent call leasing offices.

awards: [Deloitte | Databricks] JBL Flip 5 Wireless Speaker + Deloitte/Databricks Swag

problem: Finding housing and roommates is one of the most stressful parts of college.
solution: Collects preferences, matches compatible roommates, recommends apartments for the group and uses a voice agent to schedule tours and ask questions.
demo_moment: Team-described: form a group and watch the agent call an office.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Deloitte | Databricks] JBL Flip 5 Wireless Speaker + Deloitte/Databricks Swag” among 112 submissions.
Answers the sponsor's local housing brief end to end.

lessons: Finish with an action, like booking the tour.
